name: site_discovery_cc

sources.commoncrawl: Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-39 archived .no pages (CDX + WARC range reads)
sources.live_crawl: live crawl (robots.txt honoured) of .no domains listed in the Common Crawl web graph cc-main-2026-jul-aug-sep that no other discovery source covered
sources.namecrawl: labelled organisation numbers of other companies on pages fetched by the site_discovery crawl

description: Discovery leads only, for companies without a site_discovery lead on the same domain: hosts whose home/contact/about/privacy pages printed this labelled organisation number (at most 3 labelled numbers per host; web-agency credit lines and hosts without a distinctive legal-name token in the domain or title skipped). The agent re-fetches and re-verifies every lead live before publishing any claim.
